# "3x the filament cost" isn't a price. It's a guess.

> Free calculator for makers selling 3D-printed parts: price one print from filament, electricity, printer depreciation, failed-print rate, and post-processing labor, then check whether your marketplace fee and target margin actually clear at the price you're charging.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it reads from a sliced file

- The slicer's own summary comments: PrusaSlicer, SuperSlicer, OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio, Cura, Simplify3D (grams and print time; Cura's length is weighed as 1.75 mm PLA at 1.24 g/cm³).
- A file with no summary (another slicer, CAM output, comments stripped by a print host, or Cura's unfilled `;TIME:6666` template) is timed from its moves: lookahead planning, trapezoid speed profiles, Marlin-style jerk or junction-deviation corners, and the M201/M203/M204/M205 limits the file sets. On 21 PrusaSlicer 2.7.2 files the median gap to PrusaSlicer's own estimate was 0.2% and the worst 1.7% (measured 2026-11-24; method and table in the source's eval/motion-vs-prusaslicer-2026-11-24.md). Heater waits and bed probing are not timed.
- The file is read in the browser and never uploaded.
